archiveTitle: Daily Brief | 信長の野望・飛翔: Nobunaga's Ambition: Hishou launches March 12, 2027

entries.headline: renal spring: Focus as a Kidney turns real work into help for a dog's kidneys
entries.summary: Tokoronyori has announced renal spring: Focus as a Kidney, a desktop productivity game where time spent working or studying advances the dog's kidney filtration. It is planned for PC via Steam in early 2027.
entries.verification: Two independent reports agree on the developer, premise, platform, and release window.
entries.timeNote: The earliest selected source timestamp converts to 2026-11-25 12:40 Beijing time, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: 大戦略SSB2: Daisenryaku SSB2 begins Season 2 with new systems and a major DLC
entries.summary: SystemSoft Beta has launched Season 2 for Daisenryaku SSB2. The free update adds systems including Technology, while the Power-Up Kit DLC introduces an SRPG-style campaign mode.
entries.verification: Two independent reports agree on the Season 2 launch and its principal additions.
entries.timeNote: The selected verifiable source timestamp converts to 2026-11-26 09:00 Beijing time, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: めっちゃカメレオン update 4.3.0 adds a Dark Deception collaboration map
entries.summary: Update 4.3.0 for めっちゃカメレオン is out on Steam and Nintendo Switch 2, adding the Dark Deception map Monkey Business, spectator mode, and motion-sickness options.
entries.verification: Two independent reports agree on the version, platforms, collaboration map, and added features.
entries.timeNote: The earliest selected source timestamp converts to 2026-11-25 17:37 Beijing time, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: 信長の野望・飛翔: Nobunaga's Ambition: Hishou launches March 12, 2027
entries.summary: Koei Tecmo will release Nobunaga's Ambition: Hishou for PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC via Steam on March 12, 2027, with a collaboration with the anime As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World also announced.
entries.verification: Two independent reports agree on the date, platforms, and collaboration announcement.
entries.timeNote: The earliest verifiable selected source timestamp converts to 2026-11-25 21:16 Beijing time, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Incremental mining game Mello & Omega announced for PC
entries.summary: Secret Character has announced Mello & Omega, an incremental game about mining ore, forging weapons, and automating a shop. It is planned for PC via Steam in spring 2027.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report supports the developer, premise, platform, and release window.
entries.timeNote: The selected source timestamp converts to 2026-11-26 03:00 Beijing time, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: PlayStation Plus Monthly Games – December 2026: PlayStation Plus announces its December 2026 Monthly Games lineup
entries.summary: Sony Interactive Entertainment has announced the December 2026 Monthly Games lineup for PlayStation Plus Essential, with all games becoming available on December 1.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report explicitly relays Sony Interactive Entertainment's lineup announcement; no unreadable game names are added.
entries.timeNote: The selected source timestamp converts to 2026-11-26 00:32 Beijing time, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: DIFFERENCE HOUSE ― 51の違いを見つけるまで出られない: Spot-the-difference game DIFFERENCE HOUSE launches on Steam
entries.summary: Makoda has released DIFFERENCE HOUSE: Until You Find All 51 Differences for PC via Steam. Players move between matching rooms and search for differences across five areas.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report supports the developer, platform, launch, and core mechanic.
entries.timeNote: The selected source timestamp converts to 2026-11-25 18:13 Beijing time, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: The 8-Bit Big Band removes 37 Nintendo arrangements over licensing issues
entries.summary: The 8-Bit Big Band says some Nintendo arrangements were not properly licensed and has removed 37 tracks from YouTube, with some also taken off streaming services.
entries.verification: The opened VGC report supports the count, affected platforms, Nintendo connection, and the band's explanation.
entries.timeNote: The selected source timestamp converts to 2026-11-25 23:26 Beijing time, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Online card game デジモンアリシオン launches on smartphones
entries.summary: Bandai has launched the free-to-play online card game デジモンアリシオン for smartphones, retaining the strategic framework of Digimon Card Game.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report explicitly relays Bandai's launch announcement and supports the platform, business model, and genre.
entries.timeNote: The selected source timestamp converts to 2026-11-25 19:21 Beijing time, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: ホロライブ麻雀 -ホロじゃん-: Hololive Mahjong: Holojan launches with 37 Hololive members
entries.summary: Cover and Aiming have launched Hololive Mahjong: Holojan on smartphones and PC with 37 Hololive members. The browser version has been delayed with no new date announced.
entries.verification: Two independent reports agree on the service launch, platforms, roster size, and browser-version delay.
entries.timeNote: The selected verifiable source timestamp converts to 2026-11-25 15:30 Beijing time, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: White Knuckle hits a new concurrent-player peak after a major update
entries.summary: Dark Machine Games has released a major update for the PC early-access climbing roguelite White Knuckle, adding a heavily mechanized new area. Steam concurrency reached a new all-time high after the update.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report supports the developer, update date, new area, and concurrency trend.
entries.timeNote: The selected source timestamp converts to 2026-11-25 13:31 Beijing time, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Leaked Grand Theft Auto VI data used in unofficial PC port attempts
entries.summary: Users are attempting unofficial PC ports with illegally leaked Grand Theft Auto VI data; some projects have stopped after copyright claims. The report also documents extensive reliance on generative AI in the porting work.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report supports the leaked-data, unofficial-port, copyright, and AI-use boundaries; no project is presented as a working release.
entries.timeNote: The selected source timestamp converts to 2026-11-25 16:56 Beijing time, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Slay the Spire 2 beta update v0.114.0 focuses on the Fool
entries.summary: Mega Crit has released beta update v0.114.0 for Slay the Spire 2 on PC, adding cards, reworking existing cards, and making balance changes centered on the Fool.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report explicitly relays Mega Crit's beta update and supports the version and scope.
entries.timeNote: The selected source timestamp converts to 2026-11-25 14:52 Beijing time, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Arknights: Endfield adds Daigan to the weekly weapon exchange
entries.summary: Hypergryph and GRYPHLINE released a new version on November 25. AUTOMATON reports that the Administrator-themed weapon Daigan has joined the weekly weapon exchange lineup until 1:00 p.m. JST on December 2.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report supports the operators, version release, weekly exchange addition, and deadline; this remains a single-media report.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp converts to 2026-11-25 20:37 Beijing time, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI animation director says each item interaction uses three animation sets
entries.summary: IGN reports that gameplay animation director Mike Jones said Rockstar created single-handed, two-handed, and hands-free animation sets for each item interaction, supporting the system that lets characters carry different objects at the same time.
entries.verification: The opened IGN Games report directly relays the named animation director's production-detail disclosure; the fact boundary remains limited to that relay.
